{{Quote|To galactic south, the Neo-Crusaders left Eres in ruins, raided Azure and Contruum, and linked up with Mandalorian units at Dxun.|From [[Vilnau Teupt]]'s "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]," [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
While the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] were invading [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] territory during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] conflict, in [[3962 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the two '''did battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Azure/Legends|Azure]], which the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] had also [[Raid on Azure|raided]] earlier.<ref name="Warfare" /> The Mandalorians planned to take control of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] as a result of a campaign they called [[Mandalorian Triumph]], which was an offensive push originating from their territory. Their first target was<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Eres III]], which they [[Battle of Eres III|devastated]] before moving to be victorious at Azure. Next, they [[Battle of Contruum|attacked]] the planet of [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] before moving further Coreward.<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="Warfare" />

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], [[Vilnau Teupt]] delivered the [[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul|keynote address]] at the four-hundred-twelfth [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]], in which he spoke on the Mandalorian race's development, mentioning Mandalorian Triumph and the battle at Azure during his overview of the Mandalorian Wars.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first referenced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] and released in [[2009]]. The [[Azure system (Mid Rim)/Legends|Azure system]] was indicated on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing [[Star system/Legends|systems]] that hosted battles of the Mandalorian Wars.<ref name="Atlas" />
